svg.text: Crosstrainer adapter board – perfboard layout, component side view (5 x 7 cm, 18 x 24 holes)
Solid coloured lines = bare wire / solder bridges on the BOTTOM side (seen through the board). Dashed = insulated wire on the TOP side. Hole (1,1) is top-left.
1. bottom rails cols 2-5 and GND bus row 14 (bare wire)
2. resistors, diode (band right), Q1 (flat side down)
4. remaining bottom links, then the top jumper
5. pigtail wires J1/J2 from the top
6. check with meter: no short 5V_MACH-GND, DOUT-GND
swap the two pigtail pairs if
